messages:
amanda: Quick sync — we need to finalize gating & fallback rules for the global segmentation initiative. Sales pushed for region pinning + tenant isolation in the same release; ops warned about capacity. Let's decide GA vs stretch.

riya: Agree. Suggest GA must include: per-tenant region pinning, basic SLA tiers, and a canary + auto-rollback flow. Everything else deferred.

chen: From infra: propose strict, testable gates:
- Gate 1: p95 tail latency under configured SLO on representative synthetic load
- Gate 2: KV-cache hit-rate stable (no miss-storm for 30m)
- Gate 3: migration playbook + traffic-shaping API

dave: Ops requirements:
- Add util thresholds and automated actions: at 85% GPU util for 3m -> pick one: throttle best-effort, divert to fallback model, or expand burst (if allowed).
- Need an ops decision matrix with clear owner and runbook links.

lucas: Customer asks (top 3):
- Customer A: region pin + audit logs for compliance
- Customer B: soft-eviction + cost predictability (dedicated pool)
- Customer C: cross-region failover with data-residency opt-out
All want GA in ~12 weeks.

amanda: Map asks -> components quickly:
- region pinning -> routing policy + tenant config
- audit logs -> control-plane + KMS integration
- soft-eviction -> scheduler + billing signals

chen: Routing design notes:
- Policy precedence: tenant-config > affinity-tag > global-default
- Enable per-request ops override (emergency)
- Policy table must be small/cache-friendly to avoid per-request scans

riya: Draft GA checklist (short):
1) routing precedence semantics + unit/integration tests
2) tenant affinity API/UI + RBAC controls
3) SLA enforcement hooks + SLO verification harness
4) canary rollout + automated rollback
5) Console telemetry: cost/policy per-tenant

dave: Fallback presets idea (ops-friendly): preserve-quality / preserve-latency / preserve-cost. Example config:
```
fallback_policy:
  presets: preserve-quality
  options:
    - prefer_variant: [same_model_quant8, smaller_model_fp16]
    - max_price_multiplier: 1.4
    - cooldown_seconds: 30
```
We also need a numeric quality delta threshold to allow auto-fallback.

riya: Yes — add an evaluation harness that measures quality delta (embedding-sim / task-specific metric) and set a default threshold, e.g., <=3% quality loss allowed for latency-preserving fallbacks.

chen: Migration playbook sketch: drain traffic to target slice, verify KV state sync, quiesce for a client window, switch routing flags, monitor for 15m, rollback conditions defined.

sre-bot: Reminder — cache eviction storm last week impacted latency. Incident: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-0421

dave: That incident pushes me to recommend conservative thresholds. For canaries target 70% util headroom, not 85%.

lucas: We need SLA-tier mapping for contracts: Standard (best-effort), Assured (dedicated + soft-eviction), Enterprise (reserved + hard isolation). I'll draft contract wording.

amanda: Action items & owners:
- chen: routing precedence + caching strategy doc (due Tue)
- riya: GA checklist + customer mapping (due Wed)
- dave: ops decision matrix + fallback presets (due Wed)
- lucas: customer ask pack + contract language (due Mon)

amanda: If no major blockers, I'll synthesize into an RFC today and open an async vote (essential vs deferred). Call out any blockers now.

chen: No infra blockers; will post design doc by Tue.

riya: Starting mapping now.

dave: Will draft runbook sections and presets.

lucas: Syncing contracts, will share wording.

amanda: Thanks all :thumbsup:
